name: Triodos Foundation donations: Natuur & biodiversiteit
summary: Donations of typically EUR 5,000 to 20,000, covering at most a quarter of the budget, for Dutch non-profits whose projects protect, restore and raise the profile of nature and biodiversity. A quickscan comes first, then a full application with quarterly review.

amount.note: Covers at most 25% of the project budget.

calls.label: Standing applications, quarterly review
calls.recurring: Quarterly cut-offs 31 Mar, 30 Jun, 30 Sep and 31 Dec; decisions in June, September, December and March.
